intro: Jamaica is a mountainous Caribbean island with beaches, rivers and waterfalls.

chapters.title: Land
text: The Blue Mountains, home of famous coffee, rise to Blue Mountain Peak at 2,256 m. Dunn's River Falls tumbles onto a beach. Cockpit Country is a rugged limestone landscape where the Maroons once lived.

chapters.title: Hurricanes
text: Hurricanes can hit from June to November.

keyTerms.meaning: Limestone landscape with caves and sinkholes.

places.title: Landscape tour
places.intro: Places that show the variety of Jamaica's landscapes. The numbers match the pins on the map.
